name: Ed TSUWAKI
introduction: Artist, born in Hiroshima, in 1966. Learning art and design by self-education and started his career in late 1980's. His unique touch of women illustration is compared to Japanese "Bijin-ga" and highly regarded from mode magazines such as "VOGUE" "Wallpaper*". He also established own apparel brand "nakEd bunch" as the designer (which closed in 2010). Recent years, he hosts own exhibitions with different themes, from his first one "Ed-ten(94') to "DESSERT HOUSE" "CoCo" and "Panspermia". In 2015, he published his first collection of abstract paintings named "QUAKENESS" (this project still in progress). In 2017, held his first ceramic art exhibition "Salt Honey".
